name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 5 visits over 59 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2026-01-12, at wavelengths from 0.93 to 4.75 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
